node.statement: Since a <= C_path and A >= 0, a*A <= C_path*A. By def-approximate-unitary-space, X in calUbar_r means that X has a right inverse and ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J|| <= 2r; therefore calUbar_{a*A} is contained in calUbar_{C_path*A}. Applying this to each Z_t supplies exactly the larger-radius membership required in node 1, while every other conclusion already matches verbatim.
